title: Atoms, elements, compounds and the periodic table: question set (20 marks)
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Review of Key Stage 3 and working scientifically (9C)
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 54 (Atoms and periodic table question set (20 marks) and mark scheme (portal))
intro: Lesson 54. Use the periodic table on the next page. Answer every question.

questions.a: A substance made of only one type of atom
Two or more elements chemically joined

questions.q: How many atoms are in one molecule of H₂SO₄? How many elements?
Name the three particles in an atom and where each is found.
questions.a: Protons and neutrons in the nucleus (2); electrons around the nucleus (1)

questions.q: What is a row of the periodic table called? A column?
Group 1 metals react with water. Name the products when sodium reacts with water.
Predict how rubidium reacts with water compared with potassium. Explain.
questions.a: More violently (1): reactivity increases down Group 1 (1)

questions.q: Why are the Group 0 gases unreactive?
questions.a: They have full outer shells of electrons

questions.q: Is CO₂ an element, a compound or a mixture? Explain.
questions.a: A compound (1): carbon and oxygen atoms chemically joined (1)

questions.q: Why did Mendeleev leave gaps in his periodic table?
questions.a: For elements not yet discovered (1); he predicted their properties (1)

questions.q: Give two properties of most metals.
questions.a: Shiny, good conductors of heat and electricity, malleable, high melting point (any two)
